QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Brain Painting
QuestInfo.0: The Masked Gentleman needs help with 'something' that is hindering his Halloween Masquerade preparations.\nSee if you can help.
QuestInfo.1: The Masked Gentleman needs help clearing the zombies out of his basement.\nTalk to the Masked Gentleman to enter the basement, and report back when the zombies are gone.
QuestInfo.2: You got rid of the zombies in the basement for the Masked Gentleman.\nNo matter how great they look, zombies are not allowed at a masquerade!

0.0: Zombies have no place at a masquerade! What's worse than being eaten by your dance partner, hm? Being eaten by smelly old zombies, that's what! I need you to act an agent of zombie destruction and clear my basement. There's one REALLY big one down there too. Don't let him get away.\nWell come on, let's have your answer.

yes.0: You can get into the secret passage to my basement the from the Dimensional Mirror.\nBut it wouldn't be a secret if I just let everyone in there.\nYou have to promise to help me first.

no.0: You heartless monster! You're not invited to my masquerade ball anymore. I don't know that we're still HOLDING the masquerade, but you're definitely not invited.

1.1: You... smell like you took a zombie shower. I, uh, well, would you mind NOT being at my masquerade?

yes.0: Thank you for taking the time to obliterate the undead. You'll find a small gift in your inventory.

mob.0: My mansion will not be fit for raucous partying until those undead beasts have vacated the premises. All of them!

yes.0: Hey, come back later too, okay? This marathon's going to take a LOT of Other Ether to get through. Probably a lot of cheesy puffs and diet soda too.
